blocks.text: Paint Colors for your Home: Choosing the of Best Sherwin-Williams

If you’re planning to paint your home in 2025, choosing the right color can feel like both the most exciting and most overwhelming part of the process. Sherwin-Williams, one of the most trusted names in paint, has unveiled its top trending colors for the year ahead and they’re perfect for Pacific Northwest homes. At Black Pearl Painters, we help homeowners throughout Tacoma, Puyallup, and surrounding communities bring these beautiful hues to life with expert guidance, professional prep, and flawless results.
So, what’s trending in 2025, and how can you make sure your home reflects your personal style while still embracing the unique lighting and mood of the Pacific Northwest? Let’s take a look.
Sherwin-Williams Colors of the Year: What’s Trending in 2025?

Sherwin-Williams has predicted a palette that leans into comfort, nature, and subtle sophistication for 2025. These hues are soft, grounded, and deeply inspired by our environment, something Northwest homeowners can easily relate to.
1. Persimmon (SW 6339)

A soft, earthy terracotta with just a hint of pink, Persimmon adds warmth without overwhelming a space. It’s a great accent wall choice or cabinetry color for those who want a bold but approachable tone.
2. Silvermist (SW 7621)

This blue-green-gray hybrid brings serenity into any space. It’s ideal for bedrooms, bathrooms, or exterior siding, especially in areas like Gig Harbor or Olympia where natural light can vary dramatically.
3. Urbane Bronze (SW 7048)

A rich, dark brown-gray, Urbane Bronze remains a favorite for doors, trim, and accent features. It adds depth and contrast to otherwise neutral palettes and stands up beautifully to the gray skies common in the PNW.
4. Alabaster (SW 7008)
A timeless soft white that’s perfect for interiors. It reflects light gently, making it ideal for kitchens or living rooms where natural sunlight is limited.
5. Evergreen Fog (SW 9130)
The 2022 Color of the Year continues to trend into 2025 thanks to its soft sage tone. It’s calming, adaptable, and a natural fit for Northwest interiors and exteriors alike.

blocks.text: Choosing the Right Sherwin-Williams Color for Your Pacific Northwest Home

The PNW has its own unique personality and so should your home. But choosing the perfect paint color involves more than following trends. Here’s how we at Black Pearl Painters help homeowners find the right shade that suits their space, their light, and their lifestyle.
1. Understand the Light in Your Home
In Northwest Washington, we experience long, gray winters and shifting daylight. That means certain paint colors may look different depending on the time of day or season.

items: Cool-toned colors can feel colder in rooms with minimal natural light.
Warm tones like Persimmon or Alabaster can help make your space feel cozier and more inviting during darker months.
Test samples on multiple walls to see how they shift throughout the day, we can help with that!

blocks.text: 2. Coordinate With the Natural Environment
PNW homeowners often want their interiors and exteriors to reflect the surrounding landscape. Think of evergreen trees, driftwood, rainy skies, and rocky coastlines.

items: Earthy greens like Evergreen Fog blend beautifully with natural scenery.
Neutrals like Silvermist or Urbane Bronze offer a modern, grounded look.
Lighter shades such as Alabaster work well as a versatile backdrop.

blocks.text: We recommend choosing tones that complement, not compete with, your views and surroundings.
3. Consider the Function of the Space
Each room in your home serves a different purpose and your color choices should reflect that.

items: Kitchens and bathrooms benefit from high-light-reflective neutrals like Alabaster for a clean, bright feel.
Bedrooms and living areas can take on bolder hues like Persimmon or Silvermist for warmth and personality.
Home offices look sharp with darker, grounding colors like Urbane Bronze for a professional but cozy vibe.

blocks.text: Whether you’re painting one room or your entire home, Black Pearl Painters can guide you through selecting the perfect finish and formula for each space.
